en.title: Four major beer makers subject to compulsory investigation on price cartel suspicions
en.summary: Japan's Fair Trade Commission launched a compulsory investigation into four major domestic beer manufacturers on suspicion of antimonopoly law violations related to coordinated price increases.

en.title: Overlooked casualties in Gaza: What can Japan contribute to Middle East peace?
en.summary: The article discusses casualties in Gaza that receive limited attention and considers potential contributions Japan could make toward achieving peace in the Middle East.

stories.title: 「キャバクラに紹介するつもりだった」 歌舞伎町で女性に付きまとい容疑 23歳男を逮捕

en.title: "Intended to introduce to cabaret club" - 23-year-old man arrested for stalking woman in Shinjuku's Kabukicho
en.summary: Tokyo police arrested a 23-year-old unemployed man on suspicion of violating nuisance prevention ordinances after he followed a woman on a Kabukicho street, though he denies the allegations.

stories.title: India set to overtake Japan as fourth-biggest economy next year, adviser says

en.title: India set to overtake Japan as fourth-biggest economy next year, adviser says
en.summary: India is positioned to become the world's fourth-largest economy next year, according to an economic adviser. The country has achieved strong job creation and income growth, though youth unemployment persists as a challenge.

en.title: Former Takenaka Corporation employee rearrested in Expo breach of trust case over apparent billing inflation in separate project
en.summary: A 61-year-old former site manager at major construction firm Takenaka Corporation has been rearrested in connection with alleged fraudulent billing on another project. He is suspected of causing over 10 million yen in damages by instructing subcontractors to inflate invoices.

en.title: Finland national arrested on suspicion of smuggling approximately 3 kilograms of cocaine
en.summary: A 56-year-old Finnish national was arrested by Tokyo police on drug trafficking charges after approximately 3 kilograms of cocaine were seized. The suspect denies involvement in the smuggling operation.

en.title: Crested ibises take flight in Honshu in second release operation in Ishikawa prefecture
en.summary: Nine crested ibises were released from a temporary cage in Ishikawa prefecture in the second such Honshu operation using soft-release methods. Two birds flew off as authorities work to establish populations beyond existing habitats in Niigata.

stories.title: Australia’s largest pension fund eyes India, Japan for private equity

en.title: Australia's largest pension fund eyes India, Japan for private equity
en.summary: AustralianSuper is expanding its private equity investments into India and Japan. Asia currently represents approximately 10% of the fund's total private equity holdings.

en.title: North Korea urged to abandon nuclear program; Chief Cabinet Secretary Kihara pledges US-Korea cooperation
en.summary: Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Kihara Tetsushi reaffirmed calls for North Korea to completely dismantle its nuclear and missile programs ahead of the 20th anniversary of its first nuclear test. He stated Japan will cooperate with the United States, South Korea, and the international community to ensure full implementation of relevant UN Security Council resolutions.

stories.title: 「粛々と刑を受けるのみ」 NHK党・立花元議員襲撃の被告に懲役12年求刑 9日判決

en.title: 12-year prison sentence sought for defendant in attack on former NHK Party lawmaker Tachibana; verdict on 9th
en.summary: A defendant was prosecuted for attempted murder after attacking former Upper House member Tachibana Takashi with a machete on a Tokyo street. Prosecutors sought a 12-year prison sentence, with the verdict scheduled for delivery on the 9th.

en.summary: Agriculture Minister Yanagi fielded inquiries after receiving local feedback concerning road budget cuts. The minister stated he does not recall the specific content of those communications.
